tools.name: vibemol_get_state
tools.description: Summarize the paired VibeMol tab: loaded structures, the active structure (atom count, element counts, center of mass in Angstrom), current mode, and camera axes. Call this first in every task.

tools.name: vibemol_list_appearance_settings
tools.description: List appearance/preset setting keys with their type, section, and current value. Use a filter such as 'surface', 'atom', 'bond', 'background', or 'camera' to keep the result short.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against key, section, and description.

tools.name: vibemol_set_appearance
tools.description: Apply appearance settings by key (keys come from vibemol_list_appearance_settings). Only the provided keys change.

settings.description: Map of setting key to new value, e.g. {"surface.isoValue": 0.03}.

tools.name: vibemol_translate_molecule
tools.description: Rigidly translate the active molecule (atoms and any volumetric grid) by a vector in Angstrom. Undoable. Use frame 'screen' for words like left/right/up/down/toward/away relative to the current view (x = right, y = up, z = toward the viewer); use 'world' for Cartesian x/y/z.

tools.name: vibemol_center_com
tools.description: Move the active molecule so its center of mass sits at the origin. Undoable.

tools.name: vibemol_history
tools.description: Undo or redo the most recent structure edit (including edits made by this connector).

tools.name: vibemol_load_structure_text
tools.description: Load a small text structure (for example XYZ written by you) into the tab. Large cube/molden files should be opened by the user directly in VibeMol instead.

name.description: File name including extension, e.g. water.xyz.

tools.name: vibemol_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current viewport as a JPEG so you can check the result of visual changes.

tools.name: vibemol_list_trajectories
tools.description: List loaded multi-frame trajectories (XYZ trajectories) with sceneId, name, frame count, current frame, fps, playing, and whether each is synced, plus the shared sync-master clock.

tools.name: vibemol_set_trajectory_sync
tools.description: Turn the per-trajectory Sync toggle on or off (the same as the Sync checkbox in the trajectory panel). Synced trajectories share one play/pause/frame clock.

sceneIds.description: sceneIds from vibemol_list_trajectories. Omit to act on all loaded trajectories.

tools.name: vibemol_trajectory_playback
tools.description: Play, pause, or jump to a frame (0-based) for trajectories. Synced trajectories follow the shared sync-master clock.

sceneIds.description: sceneIds from vibemol_list_trajectories. Omit to act on all loaded trajectories.

tools.name: vibemol_list_atoms
tools.description: List atoms of the active structure (index, element, x/y/z in Angstrom) plus the current edit selection. Page with start/count for large systems.

tools.name: vibemol_edit_atoms
tools.description: Edit the active structure with VibeMol's own Edit-mode operations (undoable, with automatic hydrogens and bond perception). operation: select (indices), delete (indices), set_element (indices, element), add (element, position [x,y,z] Angstrom), move (indices, delta [dx,dy,dz] Angstrom, frame world|screen). After 'select', selection-based buttons found via vibemol_list_controls act on those atoms.

tools.name: vibemol_list_controls
tools.description: Discover VibeMol's user-interface controls (buttons, toggles, sliders, dropdowns, tabs) with a ref, label, section, and current state. This reaches every feature in the UI, including new ones: search with a query like 'theme', 'sidebar', 'atom size', 'visibility', 'orbital', 'export'. Hidden controls (in closed panels) are omitted unless includeHidden is true.

tools.name: vibemol_operate_control
tools.description: Operate a control found with vibemol_list_controls, as a user would. action 'click' presses buttons/tabs/menu items; action 'set' sets a checkbox/switch (true/false), slider, number or text field, color, or dropdown value. Returns the control's state afterwards; take a screenshot to confirm visual effects.

tools.name: vibemol_press_key
tools.description: Press a VibeMol keyboard shortcut (e.g. key 'e' for Edit mode, 'Escape', 'Delete', key 'z' with meta for undo on macOS). Read the shortcut list with vibemol_read_text ref 'helpOverlay'.

tools.name: vibemol_read_text
tools.description: Read the visible text of a panel or element by ref (an element id or a ref from vibemol_list_controls), e.g. 'helpOverlay' for keyboard shortcuts, or a properties/measurement panel. Omit ref to read the whole page.

tools.name: vibemol_run_script
tools.description: Last resort for things no other tool can reach: run JavaScript in the VibeMol tab (async function body; the page's window is available as VibeMol and globally; return a JSON-serializable value). Only works if the user ticked 'Allow scripts', and the user must approve each script in a dialog. Explain the purpose in plain words.
